sites_time: Identifies both records, directions and the May 1–31 2023 common window (31 approved daily means each).
volume: Monthly common-support totals for both stations match the original records and declared units within 1%.
raw_claim: Evaluates the draft’s tenfold raw-volume threshold with the correct numerator, denominator, ratio and direction.
areas: Uses both NWIS drainage areas with the correct units and matches them to the right station IDs.
normalized: Computes the larger-to-smaller area-specific ratio within 1% and correctly disposes of the second tenfold claim.
sensitivity: Evaluates independent ±5% flow perturbations for both ratios or supplies mathematically equivalent limits, and labels this a desk scenario.
provenance_and_limits: Cites daily-value and station-area records separately; bounds conclusion to the observed month and avoids unsupported hydrological causes or long-term generalization.
